body.x: Scosche injected a bit of California color into its new lobeDOPE Headphones today at the 2013 international CES. The Ventura County based company launched the line of on-ear headphones in red, black, blue, green, orange gray and pink to match any customer’s personal sense of style.

“We find our inspiration in the unique local culture and music scene and strive to develop consumer products that reflect our rich heritage in audio,” said Kas Alves, Executive Vice President Scosche Industries. “Those influences are evident in the new lobeDOPE headphones, which bring a taste of Sothern California to our customers across the globe.”

The stylish new on-ear headphones feature a lightweight polymer construction and ear cushions that conform to the user’s unique ear shape for comfortable extended listening. The headphone’s powerful 40mm drivers are optimized for any musical genre.
The new lobeDOPE Headphones will be on display along with all of Scosche’s award winning products and apps in the North Hall, Booth 3806 at the Las Vegas Convention center January 8-11th, 2013.
